dedupe_keys.name: gridded 1km physical river characteristics for the uk v2

description: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology publishes version 2 of the gridded physical river characteristics for the United Kingdom. Five 1 km raster files provide drainage directions in two coding systems, upstream catchment area, bankfull river width and bankfull river depth. A table locates 1,499 National River Flow Archive gauges on the grid and reports catchment-area matching error. The EIDC record supplies NetCDF and a comma-separated table on the British National Grid. Access is open and free under the Open Government Licence v3.0. The static product was published in 2022; individual source observations have different dates. Terrain-derived drainage and regression-based channel dimensions are approximations, which limits site-scale interpretation. The gauge-alignment errors should be checked before linking time series. Modellers could use the files to assemble consistent river-routing or inundation simulation inputs at a national scale. They complement gauge observations by supplying a shared network geometry and channel characteristics, but do not replace surveyed cross-sections for local design.
